name: BGE-m3-ko
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from BAAI/bge-m3 (config.json max_position_embeddings 8194). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
attention_variant: Inherited unchanged from BAAI/bge-m3: 24 full GQA layers (kv heads 16, head_dim 64) and 0 other layers, per the base config.json.
notes: ADDED 2026-10-23. A finetune of BAAI/bge-m3, not a new base model: same config.json, same 0.568 parameters (identical tensor set). Recorded as a contender because it publishes benchmark evidence against its own base; the evidence rows below are card-sourced and marked vendor_claim. Licence apache-2.0, repo created 2024-09-17. CARD-TABLE COMPLETION 2026-11-01: the record held only top-1 F1 (74.56). The card publishes four Top-k blocks (1/3/5/10), each with F1, Recall, Precision, mAP, mRR and NDCG against eleven baselines, and fifteen of those cells were unrecorded (top-1 F1 was already the recorded row). Added them with the top-k cutoff in the name. Read the caveat before comparing: the card's own tables print F1 = Recall = Precision = mAP = mRR = NDCG at top-1, which is degenerate reporting rather than six independent measurements, and Precision falls as top-k rises (0.746 -> 0.301 -> 0.186 -> 0.097) while Recall climbs to 0.974 - i.e. this model optimises the shortlist, not rank-1 precision.
